common.joint_order: contract-bound exact tuple; R14 FR3 order is fr3_joint1..7, fr3_finger_joint1..2

simulation_drive_effort.physical_definition: Isaac articulation drive effort command applied over the following interval; not a sensor torque

simulation_applied_effort.physical_definition: Isaac articulation effort readback actually applied by the physics actuator

simulation_projected_effort.physical_definition: Isaac projected/measured generalized joint effort from the solver; not a motor sensor

simulation_joint_reaction_torque.physical_definition: Isaac joint reaction torque reported by the physics joint/body interface

model_inferred_torque.physical_definition: model-inferred LHS torque M(q)qdd+c(q,qd)+g(q), not actuator effort

real_fr3_tau_J.physical_definition: libfranka RobotState.tau_J measured joint torque on the robot
real_fr3_tau_J.validation: REAL_API_VALIDATED only after exact API, calibration, timing, sign, and order evidence

estimated_external_torque.physical_definition: observer residual estimate of external generalized torque on the robot

notes: All signal identity, physical definition, sign, units, frame, timestamp, period, freshness and evidence hash are checked by source_adapter.py.
Simulation values carry SIMULATION_CANDIDATE provenance and cannot be labelled libfranka tau_J.
Model inferred torque and estimated external torque are rejected as actuator inputs.
Real tau_J requires exact libfranka::RobotState.tau_J identity, REAL_API_VALIDATED status, and franka_control_time_s clock.
Rejected samples do not advance the adapter sequence/timestamp cursor.
